registry.description: Covetousness is the desire to possess what belongs to someone else — not just wanting something similar but wanting that particular thing, which requires taking it from its present owner. The Greek term (pleonexia) literally means wanting more, the insatiable appetite to have and accumulate. It is listed alongside idolatry in the New Testament because it reveals where a person's ultimate trust lies: in what they can possess rather than in God. Covetousness is the heart curved inward on its own security.
